发一次最小搜索验证凭证是否可用（会消耗 1 次搜索配额）: Sends one minimal search to verify the credential works (uses 1 search quota)
如 cn / us；留空用上游默认: E.g. cn / us; leave blank to use the upstream default
如 zh-CN / en；留空用上游默认: E.g. zh-CN / en; leave blank to use the upstream default
它不是自建索引，而是替你去抓 Google 的搜索结果页，再解析成 JSON 返: It doesn't build its own index — it fetches Google's search results page on your behalf and parses it into JSON.
按关键词搜索网页，返回标题/链接/摘要的列表: Searches the web by keyword and returns a list of titles/links/snippets
要搜索的关键词或问题: The keyword or question to search for
部分上游会给一段现成答案（Tavily / DuckDuckGo 摘要）；没有则: Some upstreams return a ready-made answer (Tavily / DuckDuckGo snippet); empty if none — we don't fake it with the first result
默认 8，上限 20（Google 单次最多 10 条）: Default 8, max 20 (Google returns at most 10 per request)
